notes_for_editor: No Poplar Grove-specific history turned up in two WebSearch queries or in the reads; the Forest Lookouts Ohio index has no entry for it. The 1978 end of staffed watches is tied in sources to Pike State Forest and to Green Ridge, not to Poplar Grove, so the story does not link Poplar Grove to that closing. County disagrees: the register says Pike County and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list says Adams/Pike; the story reports both. The Armintrout panel spells the 1978 lookout Marian Sanders and the 2017 article spells Marion Sanders; the story does not name her. Coordinates differ by about 10 m between sources. Access unknown. Brief elevation (378 m) and registration date match the register. No corrections. Story is about 200 words.
